text: My first time at the dentist, and I didn't make an appointment. I only waited about 25-30 minutes. The dentist was very gentle when scaling my teeth, spoke kindly, and constantly asked if I felt any pain or sensitivity. They filled any cavities immediately upon finding them. During the procedure, they had me rinse my mouth repeatedly, unlike some clinics I've been to where they only do it once and then finish, which is very tiring for my mouth. After the scaling and filling, the dentist demonstrated the correct way to brush my teeth in detail. I tend to brush too hard and have gum problems, so the dentist gave me good advice. They even gave me a toothbrush and toothpaste to take home. The price was good after deducting my insurance contributions. The staff were also very polite and friendly. It was a great first dental experience!
